reviews.text: I had an appointment today to have some damage repaired to one side of my patio door frame.  They sent Zach, who was apparently with the company only a couple of months.  The picture shows how he left the job after being at my house for about 6 hours.  He had to make 2 different trips to Home Depot because he said he kept buying the wrong size and type of door trim.  So when he told me he had to go back for a 3rd time, I told him to stop what he was doing and leave.  I told him I would get someone else to finish what he started.  Then he gave me some lame excuses about his kid, and how he's new on the job, and he's not thinking straight, and a bunch of other crap I really didn't care about.  Then he said he would offer to come back at a later time and finish the rest of the work for free.  But I was so angry by this point, that I just wanted him out of my house, and I damn sure don't want him to come back again.  If anyone knows of a competent handyman who can finish replacing the trim on my door, please let me know.

Edit: IF YOURE CALLING ABOUT TV MOUNTING, you need to specify that you want the tv cord to go behind the wall, even if you already have the wall holes prepared and they will charge extra for that. Usually this is a given, but fyi this company does not recognize this and charges a separate fee as I told by the HOME OFFICE.

We requested someone to mount our TV. They didn’t have tools to pull the wiring through the wall so the tv cord can be hidden behind the wall (the holes are already set up). When I called to see if they can help with the schedule so he can have the tools, I got an AI bot (it sounds like a high pitched young woman, pretty realistic).
